summary: Tested only NEW backend changes: profession field on POST /api/auth/onboard (upsert behaviour) and GET /api/properties/{pid}/similar. All 8 targeted tests passed (100%). No _id leakage, upsert only updates profession when provided, similar-properties enforces type match + 60%-160% price band + same-locality-first ordering + limit param + 404 on unknown property. Test users (TEST_MOBILE 9998887771 & 9998887772) cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: similar_properties correctly excludes p-06 itself and filters by base type + price band [0.6x, 1.6x]. Same-locality query is performed first, then remaining results are backfilled from other localities — matches spec.
onboard upsert: profession is only written when req.profession is not None, so subsequent calls without profession preserve the existing value. Good.
All responses use NO_ID projection, so mongo _id is never exposed.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST users during run (mobiles 9998887771, 9998887772); both deleted in fixture teardown and confirmed absent from DB post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_onboard_profession_and_similar.py — reuse for regressions. Existing 73-test suite was intentionally NOT rerun per this iteration's request.
